words: DB-b-293 edits the two contracts only. The source table contract goes from 0.4.5 to 0.4.6: one conditional column history_scope_claim (string, not nullable, value inferred, method first value day vs source floor, sitting outside optional_columns), one appended supersedes entry and one rule24 key v046. The series contract goes from 0.3.2 to 0.3.3: the optional pair history_scope_claim and history_scope_basis (a const fixed text), the new history_scope_rule, a widened unreported_days_rule present_when for every firm with [] when none are missing, two reworded sentences, and one appended lineage entry carrying the 0.3.2 sha256. Both source schema hashes are unchanged and were recomputed from the columns. Not proven here: that any producer writes the column or any publisher writes the pair (the next cells), and that any reader treats them correctly.
